metric.name: byte_validated_c_translation
metric.numerator: code bytes with a byte-for-byte C build match

slices.name: reset_startup
slices.notes: Standalone C translation builds at the original address. Comparison result: 35/184 bytes equal; compiler shape and synmovq still prevent byte validation.

slices.name: geometry_program_upload
slices.notes: Behavioral C reconstruction is linked and trace-confirmed; byte match not established.

slices.name: geometry_initial_handshake
slices.notes: Production C reconstruction is linked into the reconstructed image and preserves the seven observed MMIO writes. A standalone candidate previously matched 18/76 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: texture_initializer
slices.notes: Production C reconstruction is linked into the reconstructed image and preserves the two ramps plus the 0x2080-byte table copy. A standalone candidate previously matched 17/172 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_register_clear
slices.notes: Production C reconstruction is linked into the reconstructed image and preserves the 0x4004 write. A standalone candidate previously matched 3/28 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: texture_decompressor
slices.notes: Recovered production C matches all 64 original MAME debug write-trace records (address and halfword value) from the first texture stream. Post-load RAM snapshots are intentionally excluded because later loader calls overwrite the same windows. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: texture_loader_profile_setup
slices.notes: Production C now preserves the static loader messages and their text positioning, both decoder calls, swapped destination windows, saved second-source pointer, and error-state contract. The plain-string text helper recovers 0x1cac8/0x1cc40/0x1ccd0 only; general printf-style formatting remains outside this slice. The reconstructed runtime reaches INIT with texture_status=0 after this path executes. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_float_conversion_helper
slices.notes: Recovered helper is used by the checked-in geometry table generator. A standalone candidate previously matched 3/60 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler support for the original logbnr/cvtzri sequence.

slices.name: geometry_buffer_prepare
slices.notes: Recovered C generation of all 0x2000 output words is verified by von/tools/verify_geometry_buffer.py. A standalone candidate previously matched 5/128 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_batch_submit
slices.notes: Recovered production C preserves the 32-bit command stream and FIFO writes. A standalone candidate previously matched 24/120 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_command_batch_loop
slices.notes: Static audit against 0x28c80-0x28cf4 confirms the initial handoff, four 0x800-word batches at 0x2000-byte strides, three handoffs per batch, and two final handoffs. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_auxiliary_submit_select
slices.notes: Recovered production C preserves both state checks and source/count selections. A standalone candidate previously matched 17/76 bytes; byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_pipeline_startup
slices.notes: Production C preserves the 0x28d80 mode gate and exact helper order: profile setup; conditional SHARC and geometry uploads; command/window, texture, and initial-handshake setup; conditional texture/auxiliary submission; geometry buffer preparation/submission; then the 0xffff state store. Direct invocation in the reconstructed runtime currently reaches the first texture text write then triggers MAME's i960 'Unhandled 00'; the existing flattened boot harness remains the runtime regression while this nested-call integration issue is investigated. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_frame_submission
slices.notes: Static audit against 0x28de8-0x28e7c confirms prior-phase read selection, polling until status bit 2 changes, phase toggle, and new-phase write selection. The polling condition was corrected from the prior inverse C condition. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.

slices.name: geometry_function_command_submit
slices.notes: Static audit against 0x28e88-0x28efc confirms the 0x404 function word, bit-23 command normalization, count, masked 16-bit stream, 0x1010 completion word, and final zero write. Byte validation is blocked on compiler/ABI calibration.
